principal_question: Does a mitochondrial-vs-cytosolic-translation priority survive restoring T0-supported comparator genes?
decision_use: Decide whether to fund further computational mitochondrial-specific target claims in this archive, NOT validate a target
primary_continuity_transform: replace exact zero by 0.5; positive counts unchanged; log2; subtract fixed 1024 NTC median per sample
named_sensitivity: count+1 then log2 with same NTC IDs
T0_requirement: both backgrounds real T0 mean>=40; unique physical mapping
remove_only: terminal vehicle mean>=40; keep old results separately
hierarchy: equal constructs per target-transcript, equal transcripts per gene, equal genes per pathway
primary_readout: L=M-C per sample; beta_WT, beta_KO; theta_L=beta_KO-beta_WT
main_decision_fail_condition: A sign change under fixed transform when comparator support is restored defeats support-invariant pathway-priority inference; absent independent same-claim measured validation blocks target-validation promotion regardless
positive_result_limit: Stable descriptive signs would support only context-bounded follow-up hypothesis, not target efficacy; no invented therapeutic effect threshold
previously_exposed: Original effects, support counts, SUM old projections and public source assays already read. This is not confirmatory or outcome-blind science.
source_count_provenance: Complete count export in supplied review; audit package reports exact agreement with real HDF5; this run does not independently open original HDF5
completion: Execute all six views, transcript/member decomposition, count floors, member and sample influence; use fixed SUM as contextual negative comparison; finish portfolio with go/no-go, no automatic new project
